description: Warehouse fulfilment documents of a gold sales order that the order lifecycle rail reads (portal/src/lib/sales-order/load-order-lifecycle.ts): ship releases (served) and pick lists (not served by the reporting API). Declared so the process stage graphs (ontology/schema/process/*.json) can name them; lane plx-process.

object_types.description: A sales release that authorises the warehouse to pick a made-to-ship order (SR-YYYYMMDD-NNNN). One object per app_ship_release row.

bindings.note: Portal-native rows (created by the release flow); no ETL marker, so their origin is not provable from the row (R1).

properties.name: order_ref
properties.description: Compatibility ref since Portal 8665d4d (TASK-2641): the portal SalesOrder.id for a portal order, the FM order_entry.id for a legacy release; sales_order_id is the canonical order key.

link_types.name: for_sales_order
link_types.description: The order a release authorises. sales_order_id is the canonical key since Portal 8665d4d (TASK-2641: releases and their lines keyed by portal SalesOrder/SalesOrderLine ids, existing rows backfilled from exact ids, then a unique fmId; the auto release at confirm, 1e40b64 TASK-2400, is keyed the same way). Portal's single-order lifecycle loader reads releases by salesOrderId and, when none carries it, by orderRef = the order's FM id; the Orders-list loader (attachListLifecycles) unions the orderRef releases with the order's own, deduplicated by release id (load-order-lifecycle.ts). The second binding reaches the FM order_entry twin of a legacy release only: a portal order's order_ref is its cuid, which an integer_id compare never matches.

event_types.description: Sales released the order to the warehouse.

prisma.ship_release.note: releaseNumber SR-YYYYMMDD-NNNN (unique), salesOrderId = the canonical portal SalesOrder link (TASK-2641), orderRef = compatibility ref (portal id for a portal order, FM order_entry.id for a legacy one), status ShipReleaseStatus, releasedAt, fulfilledAt; ShipReleaseLine.salesOrderLineId (not served).

portal.order_lifecycle.note: MAKE: sales order, manufacturing order, release order, pick list, then (999dac8 TASK-2396) shipment and complete from the order status; DISTRIBUTE skips manufacturing order and release order. Stale against the shipment confirm route, which gates the release per line (a DISTRIBUTE order with a MAKE line needs one).

portal.load_order_lifecycle.note: loadOrderLifecycle: releases by salesOrderId, plus by orderRef = customFields.fmId when none matches. attachListLifecycles (list path): FM rows resolved to gold by NULLIF(TRIM(custom_fields->>'fmId'), ''); releases found by orderRef are unioned with the order's own, deduplicated by id.

catalog.app_ship_release.note: Served with key id and the columns bound here.
